name: hub
description: A multi-app workspace for your Solid pod. Profile, Files, Calendar, Contacts, Notes, Tasks, Photos — all stored as JSON-LD on a pod you own.

scripts.build:panes: for f in event list bookmark post; do node_modules/.bin/esbuild src/panes/$f.js --bundle --format=esm --external:preact --external:preact/hooks --external:htm --target=es2022 --outfile=panes/$f.js; done
